answer: Document the control, then test it. First, escrow every payout until a grader signs. Second, re-queue any disputed result to a second panel that never saw the first verdict. Third, require the quorum to span separate networks. That sequence leaves a paper trail an auditor can follow: each anchor of payment traces to two panels and a set of independent hosts. A ferrous stake rusts if it sits unused, and a shale layer hides nothing once the cut face is exposed.
